tier1_machine_triage.what_it_is: the pipeline's regex relation vocabulary (leanbio-relations/0.1.0) applied to every record. A TYPE, not a judgement; its precision has never been measured and the known failure is a hedge firing a law type.

tier2_hand_adjudication.what_it_is: Two tiers, kept separate on purpose. TIER 1 is the pipeline's own machine triage over all 941 records (pipeline/leanbio/out/records.json statement.formalizable, from the regex vocabulary leanbio-relations/0.1.0) -- it is a type, not a judgement, and its precision has never been measured. TIER 2 is this file: one human-style verdict per record, read in full, for every math-bio claim (21) and for the first 30 items of the formalization queue. Nothing outside those 51 was individually adjudicated, and the scorecard says so rather than extrapolating.

records.reason: variance equals rate of change; already a registry law (fisher-ftns)
c* = 2 sqrt(sD) is an exact minimum of an explicit family
equal-investment condition cs*Nm = cd*Nd is an exact impossibility result over the Shaw-Mohler fitness

the reconciliation of biometric and Mendelian inheritance needs the covariance structure between relatives (the kinship matrix) and a limit over loci; neither is in the claim, and the pipeline types it Causation
the instability condition is an explicit polynomial inequality in six numbers
the onset relation determines k_c from du, dv and det J; the scaling is exact
vague-predicate: 'sufficient to account for the main phenomena of morphogenesis' names no quantity and no bound; it is a research programme
explicit diffusion-limit formula; already a registry law
rate equals mutation rate; already a registry law
mean conditional fixation time 4Ne, and the timescale separation from the mean loss time 2(Ne/N)ln(2N), is provable with Real.log bounds
records.outcome: WRITTEN BUT NOT PROPOSED - ran out of lake-lock window; the log inequality 4N > 2 ln(2N) was not attempted in Lean, so it is recorded as an open question, not a success

records.reason: H = theta/(1+theta) is an exact equilibrium with an exact monotonicity
vague-predicate: 'most evolutionary changes' is a claim about a proportion in an unspecified reference class; the pipeline types it Causation
sign equivalence over an explicit gradient
records.outcome: PROPOSED round 2, candidate (but NO rule-out direction: see DISCOVERY-ROUND-2.md)

records.reason: r = 3/4 versus 1/2 gives a strict separation of the favoured (b,c) region; arithmetic only
records.outcome: abandoned: the claim's own context says the explanatory claim is largely abandoned (sister-brother r = 1/4 offsets the gain), so a law asserting it would record a superseded hypothesis as a candidate

records.reason: the LMC ESS sex ratio (n-1)/2n is an explicit function of the number of foundresses
records.outcome: abandoned for this round: it CONTRADICTS the scope of the fisher-sex-ratio candidate I did propose, and the honest move is to propose it next so propose.mjs can record the pair as contested rather than leaving the tension in prose. Named in DISCOVERY-ROUND-2.md as the highest-value next proposal.

records.reason: the selection gradient s(a) is a tail sum of non-negative terms, so non-increasing in a by Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg, and zero past last reproduction
records.outcome: WRITTEN BUT NOT PROPOSED - the Finset tail-sum formulation was judged too likely to need several build cycles, and I had the lake lock shared with three other agents. Recorded as an open question with the Lean skeleton named.

records.reason: no-quantity as stated: it is the DEFINITION of an ESS. 'Every ESS is a Nash equilibrium' would be formalisable but is game theory, not a biological law, and would add nothing empirical
p* = V/C with exact payoff indifference and strict ordering either side

the ESS is a probability DISTRIBUTION over persistence times (exponential with mean V/ cost rate). Formalising it needs a measure-theoretic statement of payoff indifference across the support, which is a different order of Lean work from the algebraic candidates here, and the claim gives no cost rate
factor-of-two accounting; already a registry law
relative heterozygosity is an explicit increasing function of c/s; already a registry candidate from round 1
vague-predicate: 'far fewer species' with no ratio and no bound, and 'not explained by physical conditions' is not a quantity. Queue rank 1.

the shape claim (k = W/L^3 rises to a maximum near 30 cm then declines) needs the fitted k(L) curve for plaice, which the claim does not give and the repo does not hold. The 30 cm figure alone does not determine a function.
a genuine impossibility: a biconcave surface is not of constant mean curvature, so it is not an equilibrium fluid drop under surface tension alone
records.outcome: abandoned: needs the differential geometry of surfaces (mean curvature of a surface of revolution) in Lean, an order of magnitude more work than the algebraic candidates. Recorded as an open question.

records.reason: no-quantity in the relational sense: three measured breadth ratios (ox 1, sheep ~2/3, giraffe ~1/3) are a table, not a relation. A 'theorem' restating three numbers would be vacuous.
duplicate-of-existing-law: W = kL^3 for an isometric family is already the registry's scaling laws (scaling-area-law, scaling-bending-law) and empirical law E2
purely-historical: a rise-then-fall of species counts through geological time, with no rate, no bound and no measurable present-day quantity
untestable-as-stated: 'at most four or five progenitors' is a historical count about the deep past; it is also now known to be wrong in its own terms (a single common ancestry)
purely-historical: a statement about elapsed time before the Silurian, with no quantity any present measurement constrains

the compensation claim is a product invariance: depth x thickness is near-constant at given length, so k = W/L^3 is preserved. The plaice/haddock figures (twice as deep, half as thick) give the constants.
records.outcome: abandoned for lack of lock time; recorded as an open question and as the best remaining Thompson candidate

records.reason: methodological: which protoplasmic structures are fixation artefacts is a claim about a technique, with no quantity
purely-historical, and 'often' is a vague predicate
'hexagonal on average' is formalisable as a mean valence of 6 in a planar packing (Euler's formula gives it exactly), but the claim's conditional on contact and size variance has no stated threshold
Roux's rules relate branch angle to radius ratio, but the claim gives only an angle range (70-90 degrees for the smallest) and no radius ratio, so the relation cannot be pinned down
vague-predicate: 'exceedingly small' differences, 'resemble varieties more'
'the rate of growth varies as a simple function of direction' names no function; the coaxial-circle case is formalisable once the function is fixed, and the claim does not fix it
an exact geometry with its constants given: cap sphere radius = 2x cylinder radius, 60 degree cone, height ~0.27r. Follows from equal wall tension (Laplace) at the junction.
records.outcome: abandoned for lack of lock time; recorded as an open question. Note the registry already has physiology-laplace, so this may be a special case of an existing law rather than a new one.

records.reason: untestable-as-stated: the arbitrariness of taxonomic rank is a claim about a convention
'depends only on the ratio of growth rates of outer to inner border' is the right shape (a one-parameter family) but the claim gives no threshold ratio separating apart / touching / overlapping
exact: shoots at equal angles with lengths in constant ratio are tangent to a logarithmic spiral. Pure geometry with the constants as free parameters.
records.outcome: abandoned: pure geometry with no biological constant, so a law would constrain nothing a design can violate. Recorded as an open question with that reason.

records.reason: a real lower bound on organism size from molecule count, but it needs a protein molecular volume, which the claim does not give and the repo does not hold. With that one constant it becomes a clean impossibility.
records.outcome: declined, and named as the single highest-value MISSING CONSTANT found this round

records.reason: needs the phyllotaxis model relating divergence angle to parastichy numbers; t = 2 alone does not give it
no-quantity as stated: 'all differences of form are differences of degree in these factors' is a completeness claim about a parameterisation, not a constraint
exact thresholds given (0.3 and 0.15 of the volume) for which minimal partition wins
records.outcome: abandoned: proving which surface is minimal needs a variational argument over a family of surfaces, far beyond the algebraic candidates. Recorded as an open question.

records.reason: Plateau-Rayleigh: a liquid cylinder is unstable when its length exceeds its circumference. An exact bound (L > 2*pi*r) with a clean impossibility reading.
records.outcome: abandoned for lack of lock time; recorded as an open question and as the best remaining physical candidate from Thompson

records.reason: exact constants given (55 deg 22 min of arc, 0.3 of the radius) for the shortest bisecting wall
records.outcome: abandoned: same variational difficulty as ch08-03

records.reason: the content is causal ('because an earlier wall has become rigid'); the geometric consequence (right angles) is a definition of equal angles to a rigid wall and constrains nothing
an exact force balance: cell-cell tension above cell-medium tension gives an external angle below 120 degrees, and tension above the sum gives point contact. Two bounds with their thresholds.
records.outcome: abandoned for lack of lock time; recorded as an open question. This is the strongest unproposed candidate in the whole queue head.

records.reason: vague-predicate: 'little or no change of form', 'seldom lasts more than a season'
an exact scaling result: impulse proportional to muscle volume gives take-off velocity independent of body mass, hence equal absolute jump height
records.outcome: abandoned for lack of lock time; recorded as an open question. It is also the one Thompson item whose quantities (body_mass_kg, a speed) the engine nearly supplies, so it is the best CHECKABLE candidate left.

records.reason: vague-predicate: 'approximately constant' surface-to-mass ratio with no tolerance, and 'restores the balance of surface energy' names no quantity

round2_laws.note: A law that is a candidate is not a law that binds. The three buckets above are the point of this scorecard: 1 of 8 constrains a design property the engine actually supplies, 6 are well-formed rows waiting for inputs nothing in sim-engine produces, and 1 has no rule-out direction at all and was deliberately given no row.
